title: Creating a name another user just created is refused, window stays
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Sign in with the "Admin" role in one browser, and have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser.
  • Choose a new name for term A that no term has.
  • Start with the Credit Terms page open in both browsers.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click "New Credit Term".
  2. In your browser, type the name of term A in Name.
  3. In your browser, type 14 in the Days box.
  4. In user B's browser, click "New Credit Term".
  5. In user B's browser, type the name of term A in Name.
  6. In user B's browser, type 20 in the Days box.
  7. In user B's browser, click "Create Credit Term".
  8. In your browser, click "Create Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • User B's window opens.

Step 5:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 6:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 7:

  • User B sees "term A created".

Step 8:

  • The app's error alert shows "A term called term A already exists." Your window stays open with term A and 14 still typed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-E2: “If another user creates a term with the same name while the window is open, Create is refused with "A term called {name} already exists." and the window stays open.”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If Create or Save is refused by the server, the app's standard error alert shows the reason (the S3-R9 texts, or "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." when no option is sent, or "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." when the term became in use meanwhile). The window stays open with the user's input.”
